The Seven Major Feasts (Leviticus 23).4/12 Passover & Unleavened Bread: Commemorating Israel's liberation from Egyptian slavery (Exodus 12).
The Seven Major Feasts (Leviticus 23).5/23 Feast of Weeks (Shavuot/Pentecost): The wheat harvest, also marking the giving of the Law and the coming of the Holy Spirit.
The Seven Major Feasts (Leviticus 23).9/20-9/21 Day of Atonement (Yom Kippur): A solemn day for national atonement and repentance.
The Seven Major Feasts (Leviticus 23).9/22 Feast of Trumpets (Rosh Hashanah): A time of blowing trumpets for remembrance and judgment.
The Seven Major Feasts (Leviticus 23).9/25-10/2 Feast of Tabernacles (Sukkot): Celebrating God's provision during wilderness wandering, with rejoicing.

US Holidays.1/3 Martin Luther King, Jr. day: Honors civil rights leader for equality.
US Holidays.6/19 Independence day: Celebrates the emancipation of enslaved African Americans (Juneteenth).
US Holidays.9/1 Labor day: Honors American workers and labor movement.
US Holidays.10/2 Columbus day: Commemorates Columbus' arrival in the Americas.
US Holidays.12/25 Christmas day: Celebrates the birth of Jesus Christ.
